name: "Further, Faster, Baby!"  (2.0) -  Capt Marvel / Leadership
description_md: _____ _(This is a reworked deck (2.0) from an old version. I like this version a lot better & plays entirely different. This is now one of my strongest decks (and most fun), easily winning on expert vs any villain.)_ - _Lots and lots of card draw, leading to big turns with both fully maxed [Energy Channel](/card/01018) and big ally turn with [Lead from the Front](/card/01070) & [Avengers Assemble!](/card/03015)!_ - (_See other decks/guides at the bottom of this page...)_ ______ **Overview** - 20 to use Captain Marvel's _Rechannel_ heal/draw one card ability every turn, [Energy Channel](/card/01018), [Vision](/card/01068), and [Photonic Blast](/card/01013). Use [Enhanced Reflexes](/card/05024) for this as well. - This deck utilizes mostly Avengers ([Spider-Woman](/card/01011) is an Avenger) for bonus with [Avengers Tower](/card/03024). - You'll also find Captain Marvel (along with Black Panther) does well on resources needed for allies/Ally aspect. You'll be able to build your board quickly and set up for massive turns with [Lead from the Front](/card/01070) & [Avengers Assemble!](/card/03015). All the while energizing [Energy Channel](/card/01018). _____ **Strategy** - With this version you'll want to draw as many cards as possible with [Strength In Numbers](/card/03017), [Photonic Blast](/card/01013), [Alpha Flight Station](/card/01015) and Captain Marvel's abilities. - Try to get your Energy Channels down early, that way when you come to the end of your turn if you have any cards, just dump them into the Energy Channels. You can also get [Enhanced Reflexes](/card/05024) to do the same. - When you drop [Spider-Woman](/card/01011) be sure to flip to utilize your card draw as to be most efficient with Captain Marvel's better ability and [Alpha Flight Station](/card/01015). - Early game build your ally board and card engine ([Avengers Tower](/card/03024), [Alpha Flight Station](/card/01015). - Late game it'll be a lot easier to defend, but don't worry about [Captain Marvel's Helmet](/card/01016) or [Cosmic Flight](/card/01017) too early in the game. - Try to keep your allies on the board with [Honorary Avenger](/card/03025) and [First Aid](/card/01086). You want to try and have 5 allies on the board to take full advantage of [Strength In Numbers](/card/03017). - End game will be pretty easy and your last turn will probably be insane damage with 20 damage from [Energy Channel](/card/01018), multiple [Photonic Blast](/card/01013) and another 20-30 damage with 5 allies plus [Lead from the Front](/card/01070) x2 & [Avengers Assemble!](/card/03015). - I will edit with a more detailed write-up soon... ______ **Other Cards to Consider:** - Another [Honorary Avenger](/card/03025) - Another [First Aid](/card/01086) - [Inspired](/card/01074) (if you're playing multiplayer with Spider-Man for [Black Cat](/card/01002)). ______ _Any feedback is welcome, thanks!
